> **Decoupled.** This document loads the simulation outputs from
> [`./exploratory/runs/adhoc/`](./exploratory/runs/adhoc/) (written by [test8.qmd](../ane_originals/test8.qmd)) and the
> experimental triple from [`../data/experimental/`](../data/experimental/), then
> renders the comparison figure. **No RCWA solve here** — render time is
> seconds. Iterate on the plot freely; only re-render `test8.qmd` when the
> simulation parameters change.

::: {#load .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.interpolate import interp1d

# Real LaTeX rendering (MacTeX). Underscores in plain text need \_.
plt.rcParams.update({
    "text.usetex":     True,
    "font.family":     "serif",
    "font.size":       9,
    "axes.titlesize":  10,
    "axes.labelsize":  10,
    "legend.fontsize": 8,
    "text.latex.preamble": r"\usepackage{amsmath}\usepackage{amssymb}",
})

SIM_DIR = Path("./exploratory/runs/adhoc")
EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental")

# ── Simulation output (LX, LY, AVG; the AVG file is the (LX+LY)/2 mean) ──
STEM = "35_0.9_12.9_2.0"      # NA=35, t_oxide=0.9, period=12.9, beta=2.0
df_lx  = pd.read_csv(SIM_DIR / f"LX_{STEM}.csv")
df_ly  = pd.read_csv(SIM_DIR / f"LY_{STEM}.csv")
df_avg = pd.read_csv(SIM_DIR / f"AVG_{STEM}.csv")

# ── Experimental triple for sample 12-3, theta=30°, phi_exp=0° ──
SAMPLE_LABEL, THETA_EXP, PHI_EXP = "12-3", 30, 0
exp_files = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob(f"{SAMPLE_LABEL}_{THETA_EXP}_{PHI_EXP}_*.CSV"))
exp_repeats = []
for f in exp_files:
    raw = pd.read_csv(f, header=None, names=["wn", "R_pct"])
    raw = raw[raw["R_pct"] > 0].copy()
    raw["lambda_um"] = 1e4 / raw["wn"]
    raw["R"] = raw["R_pct"] / 100.0
    raw = raw.sort_values("lambda_um").reset_index(drop=True)
    exp_repeats.append((raw["lambda_um"].values, raw["R"].values))

R_stack = np.array([
    interp1d(l, r, bounds_error=False, fill_value=np.nan, assume_sorted=True)(df_avg["x"].values)
    for l, r in exp_repeats
])
R_exp_mean = np.nanmean(R_stack, axis=0)
R_exp_std  = np.nanstd(R_stack, axis=0, ddof=1)

print(f"Sim CSVs    : {len(df_avg)} wavelengths {df_avg['x'].min()}–{df_avg['x'].max()} µm")
print(f"Exp repeats : {[f.name for f in exp_files]}")
```

``` {.python .cell-code}
# ── Tight layout: 2 rows × 1 col at 7.5×6.5", fits in typical viewport ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(7.5, 6.5), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)

# TOP — total reflectance (sum over all propagating diffraction orders)
ax[0].plot(df_lx["x"], df_lx["R"], color="C0", alpha=0.30, lw=1.0,
           label=r"$R\,(L_x)$")
ax[0].plot(df_ly["x"], df_ly["R"], color="C3", alpha=0.30, lw=1.0,
           label=r"$R\,(L_y)$")
ax[0].fill_between(df_avg["x"], R_exp_mean - R_exp_std, R_exp_mean + R_exp_std,
                   color="C2", alpha=0.20)
ax[0].plot(df_avg["x"], R_exp_mean, color="C2", lw=2.0,
           label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{exp}}\!\pm\!\sigma$")
ax[0].plot(df_avg["x"], df_avg["R"], color="black", lw=2.2,
           label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{sim}}$")
ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$R_{\mathrm{tot}}$")
ax[0].set_title(r"Total reflectance --- SS\_12\_3, $\theta=30^{\circ}$, $\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}=0^{\circ}$")
ax[0].grid(True, alpha=0.4)
ax[0].legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.88, ncol=1)

# BOTTOM — detected reflectance within ±β/2 of specular
ax[1].plot(df_lx["x"], df_lx["R_det"], color="C0", alpha=0.30, lw=1.0,
           label=r"$R_{\mathrm{det}}\,(L_x)$")
ax[1].plot(df_ly["x"], df_ly["R_det"], color="C3", alpha=0.30, lw=1.0,
           label=r"$R_{\mathrm{det}}\,(L_y)$")
ax[1].fill_between(df_avg["x"], R_exp_mean - R_exp_std, R_exp_mean + R_exp_std,
                   color="C2", alpha=0.20)
ax[1].plot(df_avg["x"], R_exp_mean, color="C2", lw=2.0,
           label=r"$\langle R \rangle_{\mathrm{exp}}\!\pm\!\sigma$")
ax[1].plot(df_avg["x"], df_avg["R_det"], color="black", lw=2.2,
           label=r"$\langle R_{\mathrm{det}} \rangle_{\mathrm{sim}}$")
ax[1].set_xlabel(r"$\lambda\;[\mu\mathrm{m}]$")
ax[1].set_ylabel(r"$R_{\mathrm{det}}\,(\beta=2^{\circ})$")
ax[1].set_title(r"Detected reflectance --- within $\pm\beta/2$ of specular, $\beta=2^{\circ}$")
ax[1].grid(True, alpha=0.4)
ax[1].legend(loc="lower right", framealpha=0.88, ncol=1)

plt.show()
```
